The three notebooks share `fun/convergence_parameters.R`. The exact
reference, physical data, quadrature and error norm are identical. Outputs
use the original fixed filenames under `data_files/` and `data_files/tikzpic/`.

```{r}
source(here::here("sourceifupdated.R"))
source_if_updated("fun/fractional_evolution")
source_if_updated("fun/exact_solutions")
source_if_updated("fun/tadpole_convergence")
source_if_updated("fun/plotting")
source_if_updated("fun/metafunctions")
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE, cache = FALSE, echo = TRUE)
fig_count <- 0
captioner <- function(caption) {
  fig_count <<- fig_count + 1
  paste0("Figure ", fig_count, ": ", caption)
}
```

```{r}
# Parameters: edit the one shared file, then rerun all three notebooks.
source(here::here("fun/convergence_parameters.R"), local = TRUE)
tau_vector <- vapply(study_range, function(tau)
  experiment_grid(convergence_parameters$T_final, tau)$time_step, numeric(1))
study_parameters <- list(problem = convergence_parameters, alpha = alpha_vector,
                         h = h_fixed, tau = tau_vector, m = m_fixed)
```

The backward Euler time benchmark is first order. We vary the actual
uniform time step over two orders of magnitude, keeping h=1e-5 and m=8 fixed.
The helper uses interval averages of the physical sinusoidal forcing and the
same right-constant reconstruction as the direct time-stepping solver.

```{r}
# Compute the error matrix and save at the original main-branch location.
errors_projected <- matrix(NA_real_, length(tau_vector), length(alpha_vector))
for (i in seq_along(tau_vector)) {
  for (j in seq_along(alpha_vector)) {
    errors_projected[i, j] <- tadpole_convergence_error(
      h = h_fixed, time_step = tau_vector[i], m = m_fixed,
      alpha = alpha_vector[j], parameters = convergence_parameters
    )
  }
}
save(errors_projected, study_parameters,
     file = here::here("data_files/errors_projected_tau.RData"))
```

```{r}
# Verify that the fixed-name results belong to the parameters above.
saved <- new.env()
load(here::here("data_files/errors_projected_tau.RData"), envir = saved)
stopifnot(identical(saved$study_parameters, study_parameters))
errors_projected <- saved$errors_projected
```

```{r}
observed_rates <- numeric(length(alpha_vector))
for (u in 1:length(alpha_vector)) {
  observed_rates[u] <- coef(lm(log10(errors_projected[, u]) ~ log10(tau_vector)))[2]
}

theoretical_rates <- rep(1, length(alpha_vector))


p_tau_tadpole <- error.convergence.plotter(x_axis_vector = tau_vector, 
                                   alpha_vector, 
                                   errors_projected, 
                                   theoretical_rates, 
                                   observed_rates,
                                   line_equation_fun = loglog_line_equation,
                                   fig_title = expression("Convergence in " * italic(tau)),
                                   x_axis_label = expression(italic(tau)))

p_tau_nicer_tadpole <- errorConvergencePlotterLatex(x_axis_vector = tau_vector, 
                                 alpha_vector, 
                                 errors_projected, 
                                 theoretical_rates, 
                                 observed_rates,
                                 line_equation_fun = loglog_line_equation,
                                 fig_title = "$\\mbox{Convergence in }\\tau$",
                                 x_axis_label = "$\\tau\\quad(\\log_{10}\\mbox{ scale})$",
                                 y_axis_label = "$\\|u-U_{h,m}^{\\tau}\\|_{L_2(\\Gamma\\times[0,T])}\\quad(\\log_{10}\\mbox{ scale})$",
                                 color_label = "$\\quad\\quad\\;\\;\\alpha\\;|\\;\\mathtt{theo}\\;|\\;\\;\\mathtt{obs}\\;\\;|\\%\\mathtt{re}$")

ggsave(here::here("data_files/conv_rates_tau_tadpole.png"), width = 4, height = 5, plot = p_tau_tadpole, dpi = 300)
myggsave(p_tau_nicer_tadpole, width = 4, height = 5, use_mathpazo = TRUE)
save(p_tau_tadpole, file = here::here("data_files/p_tau_tadpole.RData"))
save(p_tau_nicer_tadpole, file = here::here("data_files/p_tau_nicer_tadpole.RData"))
```

```{r, eval = TRUE, fig.align='center', out.width="400px", out.height="500px", fig.cap = captioner("Comparison between theoretical and observed convergence behavior for the $L_2(\\Gamma\\times(0,T))$-error with respect to $\\tau$ on a $\\text{log}_{10}$–$\\text{log}_{10}$ scale. Dashed lines indicate the theoretical rates, and solid lines represent the observed error curves. The legend below each plot shows the value of $\\alpha$ along with the corresponding theoretical ('theo'), and observed ('obs') rates for each case.")}
knitr::include_graphics(here::here("data_files/tikzpic/p_tau_nicer_tadpole_with_mathpazo.pdf"))
```

The helper derivation and its restrictions are in `fun/tadpole_convergence.Rmd`.
Run `/usr/bin/Rscript --vanilla tests/check_convergence.R` to compare these
errors against the preserved research results and check auxiliary accuracy.
